answer: A concrete defense is the rate-limited vouch graph. Each identity may issue only k attestations per epoch, each backed by locked stake, so accounts cannot be minted for free: an attacker must fund, age and stake every node separately. Trust never spreads through a mirror of self-declared accounts; it travels only along attested edges, and a verifier reads the graph like a trellis, scoring a claim by how many independent paths reach it. Isolated clusters add no timber: they earn nothing and stake stays frozen. Attacker cost: k x N staked, aged identities.
